U.S. FDA label ibuprofen oral suspension (Strides Pharma Science Limited), DailyMed set id 38ebacc3-378f-483e-babc-76119677e7df (effective 2026-07-15, version 9): https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=38ebacc3-378f-483e-babc-76119677e7df . Label text read via openFDA on 2026-11-21. Fever and pain wording: 'children 6 months up to 2 years of age ... 10 mg/kg, every 6 to 8 hours'; 'Dosing ... in children 6 months or older should be guided by their body weight'; below 6 months 'safety and effectiveness ... have not been established'. Juvenile Arthritis (current Rx label wording, as read by the team): 30 to 40 mg/kg a day in 3 to 4 doses; 'doses above 50 mg/kg/day are not recommended', and doses above 40 mg/kg/day may increase the risk of serious adverse events. The label states no age for the juvenile arthritis dose. This table applies the per-kg limits from 6 months up to 12 years (6 to 143 months): above 10 mg/kg a dose or 40 mg/kg a day is a yellow caution, above 50 mg/kg a day is red, never above the adult maximum (dose_limits.csv: 800 mg a dose, 3200 mg a day, red). From 12 years the adult rule applies. The 12-year cut-off is an app rule (demo), not a label age.
